text:
Ethan: Quick announcement  new pilot: 'rolling-minute amortization' + updated Stabilizer credit caps. Goal: reduce invoice noise for small/seasonal accounts without changing runtime enforcement.
Ethan: Summary: 1) Rolling-minute amortization slices high short-term consumption into a 10-minute billing window before finalizing meter ticks (helps microbursts). 2) Stabilizer credit cap increased for pilot: up to $30 one-time for qualifying accounts (was $15 previously in experiments). 3) Pilot is opt-in for hosted-meter and starter-tier reserved customers only.
Priya: Important: this is strictly at the billing aggregation layer. Runtime per-second rate limits and throttling remain unchanged.
Nora: From an implementation POV: we'll add metadata `amort_window=600s` and invoice line items `amortization_adjustment` & `stabilizer_credit_v2`. Each adjustment will include `pilot_id` for traceability.
Marcus: Finance: please confirm GL mapping for `stabilizer_credit_v2` and whether it should be contra-revenue or posted as an adjustment. Also need sample invoice CSVs for accounting teams.
Finance: We'll review and respond by EOD. Also pinging tax for region-specific guidance.
Legal: Please add opt-in language: "Participation grants the company discretion to apply amortization and credits; credits are not guaranteed and may be revoked." Also confirm there's no FTC implication for advertised credits.
Support: We'll need an FAQ, sample invoices, and canned responses. Also prepare an escalation path for disputes.
Billing-bot: INFO: deploy scheduled `deploy/billing/2027-01-10/amort-v2` at 2027-01-10T04:00:00Z (2912349000).
Ethan: Rollout plan: 50 pilot accounts today, expand to 300 over 2 weeks if reconciliation & variance OK, GA in ~6 weeks pending results.
Priya: Opt-in/out flow: customers can toggle `billing.amortization` in console or open a ticket. We'll support `suppress_stabilizer` flag for customers who prefer no auto-credits.
Nora: Migration notes: backfill for previous 72h will be run for opt-ins to avoid surprise invoices. Backfill can be skipped per-account. Expect short DB CPU uptick.
Marcus: Monitoring: dashboards `billing.amortization_delta`, `invoices.stabilizer_credit_count`, `billing.reconciliation_mismatch_pct`. Alert if mismatch > 0.5% or variance > 3%.
Support: Draft doc link: https://docs.redwood/support/rolling-amortization.md (WIP). Will add screenshots and example line items.
Finance: Requesting sample invoice rows for US/EU customers to validate VAT handling.
Legal: Approved pilot clause with minor edits. Suggest adding a one-line consent in the signup UI: "I agree to participate in the billing pilot."
Ops-bot: NOTE: will announce in #eng-oncall 30m prior to deploy.
Ethan: Action items: Eng (Nora) finish migration & toggles, Finance (Marcus) GL mapping + CSV, Legal finalize wording, Support finalize FAQ, PM (Ethan) send targeted email to pilot cohort.
Billing-bot: INFO: deploy started at 2027-01-10T04:00:12Z (2912349012).
Ethan: Quick update: deploy completed, backfill running for 50 opt-ins. Backfill progress 50/50. No runtime incidents.
Marcus: Early reconciliation checks look clean; `amortization_adjustment` line items reconcile with consumed tokens.
Finance: Sample CSVs uploaded to /shared/finance/amortization_samples.csv. We'll validate tax treatment and post follow-up.
Support: FAQ + canned replies posted for review: https://docs.redwood/support/rolling-amortization.md. Ready for edits.
Ethan: Early metrics (first 24h): invoice variance down ~1.8% on pilot cohort, small smoothing wins. Will collect 72h data and reconvene. Thanks team :rocket:
